summary: Endeavour Silver filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release reporting a mechanical failure of the primary ball mill at its Guanacevi Mine, taken offline September 21, 2026, with mill head and trunnion replacement expected within roughly three weeks. Throughput falls to about 600 tpd from 1,100 tpd while mining continues; parts are on site and cost is minimal. This is an operational disruption, not a special situation. Watch Q3 production guidance and any follow-on disclosure if repairs slip, but no deal or capital-structure angle exists.
